definition: A commercial document for one customer order, identified by InvoiceNo
An invoice whose number starts with C that reverses a previous sale; its quantity is negative
Product identifier: five digits optionally followed by one or two letters for a variant
A stock code for a charge or adjustment such as postage or bank charges, not a sellable product
Identifier of a registered customer; empty for guest checkouts
Selling price per unit in the dataset currency; must be greater than zero on a sales line
Number of units on an invoice line; positive for sales and negative for cancellations
Date and time the invoice was raised
Quantity multiplied by UnitPrice for a sales line; excludes cancellations and non-product codes
Customer country, standardized to the approved reference country list
